name: Lesser Nagua
protectPrayer: Protect from Magic (Frost nagua only; none works on Sulphur/Earthen)
weakness: Frost: fire spells; Sulphur and Earthen: air spells; all take +4 damage per hit (-4 flat armour on Sulphur/Earthen)

locations.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik (Frost nagua)
locations.how: Needs The Heart of Darkness. Reach the Varlamore ruins area; exact teleport not confirmed on the wiki.
locations.note: Icicle marks drain prayer - step to another tile. Fire spells are good.

locations.name: Ancient Prison, Neypotzli (Sulphur nagua)
locations.how: Needs partial Perilous Moons. Travel to Neypotzli in Varlamore.
locations.note: 14 spawns. After 5 attacks they raise their weapon - leave melee range or lose 5 prayer.

locations.name: Tonali Cavern (Earthen nagua)
locations.how: Needs The Final Dawn. Middle/bottom floors of Southern Cavern or Sun Chamber.
locations.note: Crush weapons and specs weaken their defence.

gear.style: Frost: Magic (fire spells); Sulphur/Earthen: Melee crush or air spells

food.note: Max hits are 11-13 per attack; Frost basic attacks are fully blocked by Protect from Magic.

tips: Needs 48 Slayer.
Sulphur nagua are spectral, so Salve amulet does not work.
Moonlight potions restore prayer while boosting melee stats.
Frost nagua can be cannoned; they are in a multi-combat area.

name: Lizardmen
weakness: Slash (lizardman); shamans use poison spit up to 30

locations.name: Lizardman Canyon (east side)
locations.how: Kourend. Wiki lists spawns near Shayziens' Wall and Canyon; exact teleport not confirmed.
locations.note: Soldiers fight the lizardmen - attack ones focused on soldiers to take less damage.

locations.name: Lizardman Settlement (underground)
locations.how: Kourend caves; shamans accessible during a task only.
locations.note: 8 shamans, single combat.

locations.name: Lizardman Temple (beneath Molch)
locations.how: Molch, Kebos Lowlands.
locations.note: 6 shamans; explosions reduced from 5x5 to 3x3 here.

mustBring: Full tier 5 Shayzien armour (blocks shaman poison spit)

gear.style: Ranged with Protect from Missiles vs shamans; slash for regular lizardmen

food.note: Regular lizardmen max hit 7; shaman spit up to 30 unless blocked by tier 5 Shayzien set.

tips: Needs 75 Slayer reward points unlocked (Reptile got ripped).
Canyon is the best cannon spot for regular lizardmen.
Shamans drop dragon warhammer.
Konar tasks can drop brimstone keys.

name: Metal dragons
weakness: Stab, heavy ranged and earth spells; dragon hunter weapons give a bonus

locations.name: Brimhaven Dungeon task area (bronze/iron/steel)
locations.how: Fairy ring CKR then go north; costs 875 coins per entry. Axe (10 Woodcutting) for the north entrance.
locations.note: 5 bronze, 9 iron, 9 steel. Best for speed; target bronze.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
locations.how: Xeric's talisman or Kourend Castle Teleport.
locations.note: 5 bronze, 2 iron, 2 steel.

locations.name: Lithkren Vault (adamant/rune)
locations.how: Needs Dragon Slayer II.
locations.note: 5 adamant, 5 rune. Adamant mimics ruby bolt effect; rune mimics onyx bolt (heals dragon).

mustBring: Anti-dragon shield or Super antifire potion (dragonfire up to 50 unprotected)

food.note: Dragonfire is 5 max with shield, 0 with shield plus antifire; melee is the main damage. Judgement.

tips: Protect from Magic does not reduce metal dragonfire.
Metal dragons do not move toward you; stand out of melee range.
Adamant and rune dragons use all three combat styles and are more dangerous.
Steel and lower can be poisoned; mithril and up are immune.

name: Mutated Zygomites

locations.name: Zanaris
locations.how: Level 74 near the furnace, level 86 near the Cosmic Altar. 5 spawns each.
locations.note: Needs 57 Slayer. Ancient Zygomites on Fossil Island are an alternative unless Konar assigns Zanaris.

mustBring: Fungicide spray (to finish them below 8 HP)

gear.style: Melee or ranged vs high magic defence

food.note: Max hit 7-10; Karil's or dragonhide armour lowers hit chance.

tips: Spray needs a refill every 10 kills; buy refills from Slayer masters or get as drops.
Karil's or dragonhide armour is strongly recommended.
Melee strikes are more accurate than ranged, so use Protect from Melee.

name: Nechryael

locations.name: Slayer Tower (basement/top floor)
locations.how: Slayer ring or fairy ring to Slayer Tower, then stairs. Needs Priest in Peril.
locations.note: Safespot possible using tables and buckets.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
locations.how: Xeric's talisman or Catacombs portal.
locations.note: 14 greater nechryael; goading potion speeds kills.

locations.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
locations.how: Teleport crystal.
locations.note: 16 greater nechryael, lower crash risk.

food.note: Max hit 11 crush; death spawns hit up to 2 and ignore Protect from Melee.

tips: Needs 80 Slayer.
Death spawns will not appear if you safespot.
Nechryael are not aggressive; goading potions help lure them.
Greater variants are more profitable.

name: Red dragons

locations.name: Forthos Dungeon
locations.how: Forthos Dungeon, Kourend.
locations.note: 6 red dragons; safespot near fire/stalagmite; prayer altar nearby. Best overall.

locations.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
locations.how: Fairy ring CKR then north; needs 30 Agility and 34 Woodcutting.
locations.note: 16 spawns; safespot by pipe agility shortcut.

locations.name: Corsair Cove Dungeon
locations.how: Needs Dragon Slayer II; near a bank.
locations.note: 3 red dragons plus 2 baby dragons.

mustBring: Anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield (dragonfire up to 50 unprotected)
Antifire potion or Super antifire potion

food.note: With shield plus antifire, dragonfire does 0; melee max 14.

tips: Needs 50 Slayer points to unlock (Seeing red).
Shield plus antifire means 0 dragonfire damage.
Protect from Magic alone only cuts dragonfire to 10 max.
Bone burner unlock gives bonus prayer XP at Forthos.

name: Skeletal Wyverns
protectPrayer: Protect from Melee (bite/tail); Protect from Missiles blocks iceball

locations.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (end chamber)
locations.how: South of Port Sarim: Fairy ring AIQ, or Giantsoul amulet to Eldric's Lair, or Rimmington teleport. Shortcut needs 82 Agility.
locations.note: 22 spawns. Cannon allowed in the lower chamber only. Safespot possible after aggression wears off.

mustBring: Elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield or ancient wyvern shield (cuts icy breath to 10)

gear.style: Ranged or Melee slash with dragonbane

food.note: Icy breath is 50+ unshielded and 10 with shield; melee and ranged up to 13.

tips: Needs 72 Slayer.
Icy breath can freeze you; ancient wyvern shield grants freeze immunity.
Safespotting is very effective.
They regenerate 1 HP per 10 ticks.

name: Trolls

locations.name: Isles north of Jatizso/Neitiznot (ice trolls)
locations.how: Fremennik Isles, via Jatizso/Neitiznot. Needs The Fremennik Trials.
locations.note: Guards at Jatizso help fight; XP halved if guards land the kill.

locations.name: Mount Quidamortem (mountain trolls)
locations.how: Xeric's talisman or minecart to Quidamortem area.
locations.note: 14 trolls in the group.

locations.name: Trollweiss Dungeon (ice trolls)
locations.how: Trollweiss area.
locations.note: Poor drops and strong; not recommended.

mustBring: Neitiznot shield (needed for female ice trolls)

gear.style: Melee (stab/crush for ice) or fire spells

food.note: Max hit not on wiki page; judgement. Sharks or karambwan recommended.

tips: Trolls regenerate damage quickly; cannon helps a lot.
Bonecrusher necklace gives Prayer XP from big bones.
Thralls and Death charge speed up the task.
Fire spells are excellent on ice trolls.

name: Turoth

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.how: Slayer ring, or fairy ring AJR, or Camelot teleport then run to Rellekka.
locations.note: 22 spawns. Cannon does not damage them. Safespots available.

mustBring: Leaf-bladed weapon, broad arrows/bolts or Magic Dart (normal weapons do no damage)

gear.style: Melee with leaf-bladed battleaxe, or broad bolts

food.note: Protect from Melee negates all damage; max hit 9.

tips: Needs 55 Slayer.
Safespots mean healing is unnecessary.
Herb sack is useful for herb drops.
Bones to Peaches tablets work as stackable healing.

name: Vampyres
weakness: Feral/juvenile: any weapon; Juvinate: silver; Vyrewatch/Sentinel: Ivandis/Blisterwood flail

locations.name: Haunted Woods (Feral vampyres)
locations.how: Fairy ring ALQ.
locations.note: 19 ferals; safespottable; always aggressive.

locations.name: Darkmeyer (Juvinates, Vyrewatch, Sentinels)
locations.how: Darkmeyer; needs Sins of the Father for Sentinels.
locations.note: No safespots. Vyre noble clothing stops Sentinel aggression.

locations.name: Slepe (Vyrewatch)
locations.how: Slepe; do A Taste of Hope first.
locations.note: 10 Vyrewatch; safespottable.

food.note: Wiki gives no max hits; judgement.

tips: Needs Priest in Peril.
Juveniles flee unless frozen; Ivandis flail special stops this.
Efaritay's aid boosts accuracy and stacks with task bonuses.
Actual Vampyre Slayer unlock costs 80 points.
